title: pympleHUB
features:
Advanced Auto-Farm
Smart Progression: Automated island-to-island leveling based on your current stats.

5 Combat Archetypes: Choose between Dodge, Static, Orbit, and Strafe styles.

Precision Movement: Tween or Teleport modes with customizable speed and offset.

Advanced Kill Aura: Adjustable range, cooldown, and HP threshold logic.

Social Farming: "Follow Player" mode to sync with friends or alt accounts.

Quest Engine: Automatic quest acceptance and repetition.


lite Boss System
Live Tracking: Real-time spawn timers for all 8 World Bosses.

Summon Mastery: Support for 11 Summon Bosses with difficulty scaling (Normal → Extreme).

Boss Pity Tracker: Build pity on easy targets and spend it on high-tier bosses.

Global Alerts: Instant notifications on boss spawn and death.


Game Mode Automation
Infinite Tower: Fully automated join, farm, and replay loops.

Dungeon Specialist: Dedicated logic for Shadow, Rune, and Cid dungeons.

Boss Rush: Complete automation for Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulties.

Cross-Mode Replay: Seamlessly transition and repeat across different game modes.


Smart Loadouts & Progression
Dynamic Gear Swapping: Auto-switch Titles, Runes, Auras, Cosmetics, and Accessories.

Contextual Presets: Separate loadouts for Mobs vs. Bosses.

Optimization Profiles: One-click presets for Best DMG, EXP, Luck, Money, or Gems.

Smart Stat Allocation: Auto-allocate points into Sword, Melee, or Power builds.

Skill Tree Logic: 5 priority modes including Balanced, Glass Cannon, and Crit Build.


Combat & Skills
Full Skill Support: Individual toggles for Z, X, C, V, and F (Nuke).

Execution Modes: Toggle between Normal or Instant cast with custom cooldowns.

Haki Automation: Automatic management of Armament, Observation, and Conqueror Haki.


Shops & Economy
Merchant Bot: Automatically purchases Boss/Dungeon/Rush keys and rerolls.

Upgrade Manager: Auto-buys Rush Shop and Infinite Tower Shop upgrades.

Resource Collection: Auto-redeem codes and auto-collect Dungeon/Hogyoku fragments.


Utility & Performance
World Optimization: FPS Boost (Light/Aggressive), Island Wipe, and Object Removal.

Movement Hacks: Custom WalkSpeed, JumpPower, Noclip, and Anti-Knockback.

Teleport Hub: 70+ instant TP locations for every NPC, Crafter, and Shop.

Security: Built-in Anti-AFK to keep your farm running 24/7.
